objective: Build and integrate Company Watch/job-search agents under Career after the Career Ops foundation is ready. Reuse the historical employer/recruiter/application evidence, prefer structured ATS/career endpoints, share dedupe/application state with Career Ops, and feed eligible findings into the correct regional trackers with evidence.
prerequisites: agent-career-ops-integration-and-tracker-automation-2026-09-23 should be completed or blocked with truthful terminal evidence
allowed_scope: Verify the Career Ops integration/tracker interface before building on it; if the prerequisite is still active, do not race its files.
Locate the historical Gmail-derived employer/recruiter/application evidence already recorded in project handovers or local career data; do not fabricate missing organizations.
Implement Company Watch under Career using structured company career/ATS endpoints where practical, with bounded fallbacks and dedupe.
Share canonical application/job/company dedupe with Career Ops so Company Watch cannot create conflicting application state.
Feed eligible findings into the correct regional tracker through the deterministic tracker writer and preserve provenance/source timestamps.
Create/maintain a monthly Company Watch operational workbook only where it does not conflict with canonical application state.
Run bounded evidence demonstrating watch -> finding -> dedupe -> Career Ops handoff -> tracker update on safe/test data.
Do not submit applications or contact recruiters/companies.
Update state/tracker truthfully and commit/push recoverably.
Before terminal result, create exactly one successor agent-* task covering CV/cover-letter + LinkedIn workflow integration unless an equivalent task is already pending/running.
stop_conditions: No external submissions, messages or account actions.
Do not duplicate or overwrite canonical application history.
No secrets or raw sensitive email content in GitHub.
notes: Historical handover reports 203 confirmed/strongly evidenced employers, 18 recruiters/intermediaries and 221 organizations with application/CV evidence. Treat those counts as historical until re-verified from available source data.
